scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic proof and independently reproducible rational and polynomial checks are supplied. Previously published stage formulas and qualitative oscillations are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Two-state linear conservative systems and original second-order Heun-based MPRK only; does not apply to general nonlinear Fokker–Planck PDEs or higher-cell grids. Publication-priority uncertainty in specialist Patankar literature.
title: Sharp equilibrium-ratio maximum-principle frontier for two-cell Patankar–Runge–Kutta diffusion
